reason: The 1/1 Cryomancer trades with Enlightened Confidant, a lifegain value engine, and lands in the graveyard where its draw-two ability can be used later; not blocking just takes damage for nothing.

Torch the Tower is an instant, so holding it keeps the same exile answer to Forsaken Miner (on their turn or in combat) and leaves room for a better target; casting it at sorcery speed now gains little.

Voice of Victory stops you casting spells on the opponent's turn, so holding mana does nothing; exiling Voice (they lose 3) and using all 6 mana on Consult the Star Charts is far better than passing with nothing done.

Countersculpt is castable with the Jace you control and stops the opponent's only threat; with no cards in hand and two loaded Earthbender Ascensions, a resolved Chocobo grows fast, and No More Lies would fail against 10 open mana.
Starcage would exile only a single Llanowar Elves; keeping it for a wider board of cheap creatures and holding up Countersculpt or Three Steps Ahead for the opponent's 4-drop is stronger.

At 7 life against two large Chocobos and a Hydra, keeping three untapped blockers plus an instant Torch for the Hydra matters most; A spends life on Obsessive Pursuit and needs Gene Pollinator's mana, which taps it and loses a blocker.

Stuck on 3 lands with no land in hand and an empty opposing board, digging three cards with Winternight Stories (pitching a spare creature) is worth far more than holding Requiting Hex, which works fine at sorcery speed.
Killing Moseo keeps one Enduring Curiosity alive as a creature and removes the recursion engine, at the cost of only 1 more life than trading with Haliya; the position is likely lost either way.

At 4 life facing four attackers next turn, a Superior Spider-Man copy (for example deathtouch Cultivator) as a second blocker gives the only real chance to survive; drawing three with Winternight Stories adds no board presence.
Cryomancer develops a body, filters cards, fills the graveyard for Uldaros and can stun Confidant; evoking Deceit for a small bounce or discard throws away a premium card for little.
